messages:
maria (Docs): Heads up  I'm adding a tiny migration note for SOC2 customers switching from one-off audit downloads to scheduled exports. Need short curl + python examples (streaming), and one-line legal-approved copy about downstream retention/custody. Also want a checklist for scopes and a KMS unwrap note.

sam (Legal): Use this sentence (can be verbatim): "Exported audit datasets are point-in-time snapshots. Customers are responsible for downstream retention, deletion, and access controls of exported copies. Redwood issues short-lived export links and encrypted delivery and does not assume custody or long-term retention of exported copies." Avoid "guarantee"/"permanent".

asha (Eng): API to show: POST /v1/audit/exports with body: tenant_id, start_ts, end_ts, redact_level (none|partial|full), mask_fields[], export_ttl_seconds, retention_cutoff_ts; download via GET /v1/audit/exports/{id}/download. Examples should use export_ttl_seconds small (e.g., 1800).

troy (DevEx): I'll suggest streaming examples and a tiny jq pipe to preview NDJSON.

oliver (Security): Checklist: least-privilege service account scopes (`audit:read`, `export:create`, optional `kms:decrypt`), rotate keys used for scheduled exports, and restrict destination buckets.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch docs/audit-export-migration by asha — status: success :rocket:

maria (Docs): Draft snippets below; I'll trim for the public guide and land PR, tagging legal/security for final sign-off.

```bash
# create export (example)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","start_ts":1704067200,"end_ts":1704153600,"redact_level":"partial","export_ttl_seconds":1800,"retention_cutoff_ts":1701513600}'

# download (stream to file)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download" \
  --output acme-audit-2024-12-01.jsonl
```

```python
# python streaming (requests)
import os, requests
url = "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}"}
with requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True) as r:
    r.raise_for_status()
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if not line: continue
        print(line)
```

maria (Docs): Checklist to include in the migration note:
- required scopes: `audit:read`, `export:create` (optional: `kms:decrypt`)
- recommended example export_ttl_seconds: 1800 (30 minutes)
- retention_cutoff_ts: redacts older records from the exported snapshot
- encrypted/wrapped exports will require client-side unwrap using your KMS key; see KMS guide (link TODO)

sam (Legal): Approved. Ensure the legal sentence is near the top of the migration section.

maria (Docs): Will do. Thanks — I'll land PR #578 after small edits.
